title: Simulation 3D Probabilistic Radar
text: Probabilistic radar sensor model in 3D simulation environment, 1 output, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent vehicle, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Sample time}, {Azimuthal resolution of radar (deg)} sets the azimuth resolution of radar, {Elevation resolution of radar (deg)}, {Range resolution of radar (m)}, {Range rate resolution of radar (m/s)} sets the range rate resolution of the radar, {Fractional azimuthal bias component} sets the azimuth bias fraction, {Fractional elevation bias component} sets the elevation bias fraction, {Fractional range bias component} sets the range bias fraction, {Fractional range rate bias component} sets the range rate bias fraction, {Field of view (deg)} sets the field of view, {Detection ranges (m)} sets the detection range, {Range rates (m/s)} sets the minimum and maximum detection range rates, {Detection probability} sets the probability that radar detects a target, {False alarm rate}, {Detection probability range (m):} sets the reference range for given probability, {Reference radar cross section (dBsm)} sets the reference radar cross section for given probability, {Enable elevation angle measurements} enables radar to measure elevation, {Enable range rate measurements} enables radar to measure range rate, {Enable measurement noise} enables adding noise to radar sensor, {Enable false detections} enables reporting false alarm radar, {Random number generator method} sets the method to set random number generator seed, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator seed, {Maximum reported} sets the maximum number of reported detections, {Coordinate system}, {Specify output bus name} sets the name of output bus and {Output bus name} sets the name of output bus. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Detections
ports.summary: Object detections Simulink bus containing MATLAB ® structure

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: Unique sensor identifier 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Azimuthal resolution of radar (deg)
params.values: Azimuth resolution of radar 4 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Elevation resolution of radar (deg)
params.values: Elevation resolution of radar 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Range resolution of radar (m)
params.values: Range resolution of radar 2.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Range rate resolution of radar (m/s)
params.values: Range rate resolution of the radar 0.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Fractional azimuthal bias component
params.values: Azimuth bias fraction 0.1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Fractional elevation bias component
params.values: Elevation bias fraction 0.1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Fractional range bias component
params.values: Range bias fraction 0.05 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Fractional range rate bias component
params.values: Range rate bias fraction 0.05 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Field of view (deg)
params.values: Field of view [20, 5] (default) | positive real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Detection ranges (m)
params.values: Detection range [1, 150] (default) | positive real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Range rates (m/s)
params.values: Minimum and maximum detection range rates [-100, 100] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Detection probability
params.values: Probability that radar detects a target 0.9 (default) | real scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: False alarm rate
params.values: False alarm rate 1e-6 (default) | positive real scalar in range [10 –7, 10 –3 ]

params.name: Detection probability range (m):
params.values: Reference range for given probability of detection 100 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Reference radar cross section (dBsm)
params.values: Reference radar cross section for given probability of detection 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Enable elevation angle measurements
params.values: Enable radar to measure elevation on (default) | off

params.name: Enable range rate measurements
params.values: Enable radar to measure range rate on (default) | off

params.name: Enable measurement noise
params.values: Enable adding noise to radar sensor measurements on (default) | off

params.name: Enable false detections
params.values: Enable reporting false alarm radar detections on (default) | off

params.name: Random number generator method
params.values: Method to set random number generator seed Repeatable (default) | Specify seed | Not repeatable

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Random number generator seed 0 (default) | scalar in range [0, 2 32 )

params.name: Maximum reported
params.values: Maximum number of reported detections 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Coordinate system
params.values: Coordinate system of reported detections Ego Cartesian (default) | Sensor Cartesian | Sensor spherical

params.name: Specify output bus name
params.values: Specify name of output bus off (default) | on

params.name: Output bus name
params.values: Name of output bus BusSimulation3DRadarTruthSensor (default) | valid bus name
